intent: Make fixtures/ a real workspace member and give every later test one honest way to boot a private fixture.
change: fixtures/ added to pnpm-workspace, tsconfig references, tsconfig.test include, and vitest source aliases plus integration include; a shared harness module providing createFixtureServer (ephemeral 127.0.0.1 port, in-process), the common /__test router shape (reset, seed, state, mode), a typed control-plane client, and start/stop lifecycle. Proven against a minimal fixture defined in the test itself so the seam is not entangled with any real site.
done_when: pnpm check green with TypeScript under fixtures/; integration tests prove concurrent-instance isolation, port release by rebinding, idempotent and post-failure stop, a leak assert, and a typed error on a stopped instance.

intent: Give watch-engine a page whose observable value is settable and readable, so a price trigger is asserted rather than eyeballed.
change: fakestore (product page: price, stock, title) and fakenews (article page: headline, body) on the harness, with control-plane setters and readers, semantic markup carrying accessible names and data-testid hooks, a 404 body distinguishable from a blocked shell, and out-of-stock rendering without a price.
done_when: Integration tests prove set-render-readback equality for every observable value, that a refused control-plane write leaves the page unchanged, that the 404 body differs from the blocked shell, and that out-of-stock renders no price.

intent: Make the tier-escalation and self-healing proofs discriminate what they claim to, instead of passing by construction.
change: blocked (captcha shell to plain HTTP, content injected by script), hard-blocked (shell to an unmarked browser, content only to a request carrying the checked escalation marker), and redesign (class names, ids, and nesting rotate to a deterministic second layout while accessible names, roles, text, and data-testid stay byte-identical) on the observation targets, set through POST /__test/mode on a live instance with ?mode= retained as one-shot shorthand.
done_when: Integration tests prove blocked discriminates HTTP from browser on one URL, hard-blocked discriminates unmarked from marked and rejects a malformed marker, redesign toggles live with the URL unchanged and the semantic surface byte-identical, redesign is deterministic, an unknown mode is refused, and modes do not leak between instances.

intent: Give action-playbooks a cancellation an engine can only finish by asking the user.
change: fakegym with seeded members and cookie sessions, login, member area, a three-step cancellation flow (retention offer, are-you-sure, really-sure) with server-held progress, and a final confirmation-code gate whose code is readable only through GET /__test/member/:id/code; control-plane seed and readback of member state.
done_when: Integration tests driving a LocalProvider browser prove the full path to { cancelled: true }, that the code appears in no reachable page or response body, and that step-skip, wrong code, retention-accept (lands retained), double-cancel (idempotent), and unauthenticated access are each handled as specified.

intent: Give slot-sniping a contested resource that awards itself exactly once, so the race is proven rather than described.
change: fakedmv appointment calendar with control-plane slot publish and withdraw, a booking flow, single-winner award semantics under concurrency, and a typed gone refusal distinct from a transient failure.
done_when: Integration tests prove publish-book-readback, that concurrent double-booking leaves exactly one winner and one booking row with the loser refused as gone, and that a slot withdrawn between listing and booking yields gone rather than an error.

intent: One boot path, several entry points - a human and docker-compose start the same fixtures the tests do, through the same code, so no second implementation can drift.
change: A fixtures serve CLI built on the same start* factories the tests call, on fixed documented ports, plus a pnpm fixtures:dev script; a fixtures service added to the existing docker-compose.yml alongside postgres; and fixtures/README documenting every control-plane route, the mode contract, the X-Fixture-Escalation token, and the LocalProvider-only boundary.
done_when: The CLI constructs every fixture through the same factories the integration tests use (asserted, not inspected); a test cross-checks that the documented route list, the CLI registry, and the compose service ports agree, so documentation drift fails the build; pnpm fixtures:dev serves all four fixtures and their control planes.

intent: Make the /__test router shape actually uniform across all four fixtures, as fixture-harness-contract specifies and harness-seam's change contract claimed.
change: Mount GET /__test/state (everything the instance knows) and POST /__test/reset (return to seeded baseline) on fakestore, fakenews, fakegym and fakedmv; extend POST /__test/seed to set the whole starting state in one call, adding it to fakegym and fakedmv which today mount neither seed nor mode. Expose each on the typed control client. Re-point the documentation-drift proof so it checks mounted routes against the contract's required shape, not only against fixtures/README.md, which the same task authored.
done_when: An integration test asserts every fixture in FIXTURE_SITES mounts reset, seed, state and mode; state round-trips everything the fixture knows; reset returns a mutated instance to its seeded baseline without restarting it; dropping any one of those routes from any one fixture fails that test.

intent: Prove the post-failure teardown clause that fixture-harness-contract and harness-seam's done_when both name and no test exercises.
change: Add an integration proof to fixtures/src/harness.integration.test.ts covering a failed start: occupy a fixed port, assert startFixture rejects, assert liveFixtureCount() is unchanged so a failed start cannot make assertNoLeakedFixtures() throw in an unrelated later test, and assert the teardown path after that failure does not throw.
done_when: The new test passes on the current implementation and fails when live.set is moved above the await listen in harness.ts, proving it discriminates.

intent: Stop blocked mode reporting two contradictory states to a JavaScript-executing client.
change: In pages.ts, have the blocked shell's injected script update the fixture-state meta to NORMAL_STATE when it materializes the body, so a client that runs the script sees a self-consistent document instead of normal content still labelled fixture-state:blocked. Extend the hostile-modes proof past decoding the payload inside the test process.
done_when: A test asserts the served blocked shell's script updates both the body and the state marker, and that no captcha hook survives materialization; the executed-document proof is named in HANDOFF.md as the obligation browser-substrate must discharge.

intent: Keep the unauthenticated control plane on loopback, which is the contract's stated reason it needs no authentication.
change: Publish the fixtures compose service's four ports bound to 127.0.0.1 so 'docker compose up fixtures' does not expose POST /__test/* to the host network; keep FIXTURES_HOST 0.0.0.0, which the container-internal bind requires.
done_when: docker-compose.yml publishes all four fixture ports on 127.0.0.1; the dev-entrypoint documentation test still cross-checks container ports against FIXTURE_SITES and a drifted port still fails it.
